pe7:1.6: tattha yena cha puggalamūlāni tesaṃ nikkhipitvā rāgacarito dosacarito mohacarito rāgadosacarito rāgamohacarito dosamohacarito samabhāgacarito, iti imesaṃ puggalānaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjitānaṃ pañca nīvaraṇāni paṭipakkho, kesaṃ paṭighātāya yathā asamattho tīṇi akusalamūlāni niggaṇhāti.
pe7:1.7: lobhena akusalamūlena abhijjhā ca uddhaccaṃ ca uppilavataṃ alobhena kusalamūlena niggaṇhāti, kukkuccaṃ ca vicikicchā ca mohapakkhe, taṃ amohena niggaṇhāti,
pe7:1.8: doso ca thīnamiddhaṃ ca dosapakkho taṃ adosena niggaṇhāti.
pe7:2.4: tattha alobhassa pāripūriyā vivitto hoti kāmehi,
pe7:2.5: tattha adosassa pāripūriyā amohassa pāripūriyā ca vivitto hoti pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi. savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
pe7:3.3: tattha paṭhamābhinipāto vitakko, paṭiladdhassa’ vicaraṇaṃ vicāro,
pe7:3.4: yathā puriso dūrato purisaṃ passati āgacchantaṃ, na ca tāva jānāti eso itthīti vā purisoti vā, yadā tu paṭilabhati itthīti vā purisoti vā evaṃ vaṇṇoti vā evaṃsaṇṭhānoti vā, ime vitakkayanto uttariṃ upaparikkhati kinnu kho ayaṃ sīlavā udāhu dussīlo aḍḍho vā duggato’ti vā.
pe7:3.5: evaṃ vicāro vitakke appeti, vicāro carīyati ca anuvattati ca.
pe7:3.6: yathā pakkhī pubbaṃ āyūhati, pacchā nāyūhati, yathā āyūhanā evaṃ vitakko, yathā pakkhānaṃ pasāraṇaṃ evaṃ vicāro anupāleti vitakketi vicarati vicāreti.
pe7:3.8: kāmasaññāya paṭipakkho vitakko, vyāpādasaññāya vihiṃsāsaññāya ca paṭipakkho vicāro,
pe7:3.9: vitakkānaṃ kammaṃ akusalassa amanasikāro, vicārānaṃ kammaṃ jeṭṭhānaṃ saṃvāraṇā.
pe7:3.10: yathā paliko tuṇhiko sajjhāyaṃ karoti evaṃ vitakko, yathā taṃyeva anupassati evaṃ vicāro.
pe7:3.13: niruttipaṭisambhidāyaṃ ca paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāyaṃ ca vitakko dhammapaṭisambhidāyaṃ ca atthapaṭisambhidāyaṃ ca vicāro,
pe7:3.14: kallatākosallattaṃ cittassa vitakko, abhinīhārakosallaṃ cittassa vicāro,
pe7:3.15: idaṃ kusalaṃ idaṃ akusalaṃ idaṃ pahātabbaṃ idaṃ sacchikātabbanti vitakko, yathā pahānaṃ ca sacchikiriyā ca evaṃ vicāro.
pe7:3.16: imesu vitakkavicāresu ṭhitassa duvidhaṃ dukkhaṃ na uppajjati kāyikaṃ ca cetasikaṃ ca,
pe7:3.17: duvidhaṃ sukhaṃ uppajjati: kāyikaṃ ca cetasikaṃ ca
pe7:3.18: iti vitakkajanitaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ pīti. kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyiko yeva.
pe7:3.19: yā tattha cittassa ekaggatā, ayaṃ samādhī.
pe7:4.1: tesaṃ yeva vitakkavicārānaṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ āsevanāya tassa tappoṇamānasaṃ hoti,
pe7:4.3: yaṃ ca pītisukhaṃ ca nekkhammaṃ ca oḷārikaṃ bhavati.
pe7:4.4: api ca samādhijā pīti rati ca jāyati
pe7:4.11: yā pīti taṃ somanassindriyaṃ, yaṃ sukhaṃ taṃ sukhindriyaṃ,
pe7:4.14: so pītiyā virāgā yāti ojahi jallasaṃgahaṃ.
pe7:5.1: tattha somanassacittamupādānanti ca so taṃ vicinanto upekkhameva manasikaroti.
pe7:5.3: yathā ca pītiyā sukhamānītaṃ. taṃ kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti sampajāno viharati.
pe7:6.1: tathā kāyikassa sukhassa pahānāya paṭhame jhāne somanassindriyaṃ nirujjhati.
pe7:6.3: so sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
pe7:6.4: tattha catūhi indriyehi upekkhāpasādā hoti, dukkhindriyena domanassindriyena sukhindriyena somanassindriyena ca.
pe7:6.5: tesaṃ nirodhā upekkhāsampajaññaṃ hoti, tattha sukhindriyena somanassindriyena ca asati hoti, tesaṃ nirodhā satimā hoti, dukkhindriyena domanassindriyena ca asampajaññaṃ, tesaṃ nirodhā sampajaññaṃ hoti, iti upekkhāya ca saññā, sato sampajāno cittekaggatā ca, idaṃ vuccate catutthaṃ jhānaṃ.
pe7:7.1: tattha yo rāgacarito puggalo tassa sukhindriyaṃ ca somanassindriyaṃ ca,
pe7:7.2: yo dosacarito puggalo tassa dukkhindriyaṃ ca domanassindriyaṃ ca,
pe7:7.3: yo mohacarito puggalo tassa asati ca asampajaññaṃ ca.
pe7:8.1: tattha rāgacaritassa puggalassa tatiye jhāne catutthe ca anunayo nirujjhati, dosacaritassa paṭhame jhāne dutiye ca paṭighaṃ nirujjhati. mohacaritassa puggalassa paṭhame jhāne dutiye ca asampajaññaṃ nirujjhati,
pe7:8.2: tatiye jhāne catutthe ca asati nirujjhati, evameva tesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ cattāri jhānāni vodānaṃ gamissanti.
pe7:9.1: tattha rāgadosacaritassa puggalassa asampajaññaṃ ca anunayo ca paṭighaṃ ca, tena hānabhāgiyaṃ jhānaṃ hoti.
pe7:9.2: tattha rāgamohacaritassa puggalassa anunayattaṃ ca ādīnavaṃ dassitā, taṃ tassa hānabhāgiyaṃ jhānaṃ hoti,
pe7:9.3: tattha dosamohacaritassa puggalassa paṭigho ca asati ca asampajaññaṃ ca ādīnavaṃ dassitā, tena tassa hānabhāgiyaṃ jhānaṃ hoti.
pe7:10.1: tattha rāgadosamohasamabhāgacaritassa puggalassa visesabhāgiyaṃ jhānaṃ hoti. imāni cattāri jhānāni sattasu puggalesu niddisitabbāni
pe7:10.2: catusu ca samādhīsu: chandasamādhinā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, viriyasamādhinā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, cittasamādhinā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, vīmaṃsāsamādhinā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ.
pe7:10.3: appaṇihitena paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, suññatāya dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, animittena tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, ānāpānasatiyā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ,
pe7:10.4: kāmavitakkavyāpādānaṃ ca taṃ taṃ vūpasamena paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ hoti, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamena dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, sukhindriyasomanassindriyānaṃ vūpasamena tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, kāyasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamena catutthaṃ jhānaṃ ca.
pe7:10.5: cāgādhiṭṭhānena paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, saccādhiṭṭhānena dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, paññādhiṭṭhānena tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, upasamādhiṭṭhānena catutthaṃ jhānaṃ,
pe7:10.6: imāni cattāri jhānāni saṅkhepaniddesena niddiṭṭhāni. tattha samādhindriyaṃ pāripūriṃ gacchati.
pe7:10.7: anuvattanakāni cattāri, tattha yo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ nissāya āsavakkhayaṃ pāpuṇāti, so sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya domanassindriyapaṭipakkhena.
pe7:10.8: yo dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ nissāya āsavakkhayaṃ pāpuṇāti, so sukhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya dukkhindriyapaṭipakkhena,
pe7:10.9: yo tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ nissāya āsavakkhayaṃ pāpuṇāti, so sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya somanassindriyapaṭipakkhena,
pe7:10.10: so sukhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya sukhindriyapaṭipakkhena gato.
